integrity: A mathematical proof and a deterministic finite cross-check are included; the proof is not independently certified, and published-priority completeness cannot be guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the relational point/line-sorted incidence language and quantifier ranks through four; no assertion at rank five or about counting quantifiers, thin polygons, extra named structure, or infinite polygons. Finite covers test proof lemmas but are not generalized hexagon or octagon witnesses.
title: Four-round logical collapse of finite thick generalized hexagons and octagons
